phase2_deploy_built.title: AI Product Description Writing
phase2_deploy_built.justification: This opportunity is specifically right for Baukjen now because it can help improve product descriptions, which are crucial for AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation, while also addressing the staff digital literacy pillar score of 5.55.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen's AI Product Description Writing feature, first connect your Shopify store to the Claude dashboard. Then, create a new project and select the 'Fashion' template. Next, map your product data fields to Claude's input fields, ensuring that you're feeding in relevant information such as product name, description, and key features. Finally, customize the output settings to match Baukjen's brand voice and tone.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.
